full_judgment: 32. In Zilu Mia and others vs State 1988 BLD 418 a Division Bench of High Court Division in taking into account principles enunciated in Mani Mohan Ghose vs King Emperor 35 CWN 623 and Ghulam Kadir vs Crown PLD 1950 Bagdad-ul-Jabid 51 held that the information first received by the police whereupon investigation was started and the appellants were arrested is the first information report and is admissible but the information subsequently recorded at 11-00 PM in the night of occurrence is not admissible in evidence and therefore, it cannot be taken into consideration.
